messages:
Maya: Quick Q — flying into SF Monday with my mom who needs gluten-free. Looking for a relaxed dinner near Market & 5th around 6:30pm. Any recs? Prefer low-noise and wheelchair-accessible seating.
Josh: @Maya Check out Rocco's (two blocks over). They do GF crust and have big booths. Call ahead. :pizza:
Priya: Also recommend Juniper Kitchen on Natoma. GF menu marked, decent kids' options, quieter on Mondays.
Liam: Juniper is nice. If you want something really mellow, try Harbor Grainthey have GF fried rice and can seat you early.
Emily: Harbor Grain +1. They dim the lights early so it's calmer for older guests.
Tom: There's also Little Orchard (casual bistro). They do a dedicated GF dessert (pear galette) and have ramp access.
Maya: Thanks all. Any breakfast spots open super early (6:15) the next morning near the office?
Nina: Sunrise Alley opens at 5:45, GF yogurt parfait and good coffee. Super close.
Josh: If you need something to grab-and-go, Market Loaf has GF muffins by 6:30.
Priya: Quick poll: Rocco's (pizza, kid-friendly), Juniper (mid), Harbor Grain (quiet/casual) — vote with emoji.
Maya: Vote: Harbor Grain :white_check_mark: (quiet wins)
Emily: Vote: Juniper :ok_hand: (but Harbor sounds better for mom)
Liam: Vote: Harbor Grain :heavy_plus_sign: (agree on quiet)
Tom: Want me to call Harbor Grain and ask about a wheelchair spot/high chair?
Maya: That would be amazing, thank you.
Tom: Called and left a note for "Maya party of 3" Mon 6:30. They said accessible table available and GF options OK. Reservation code: HG-772.
Maya: Perfect, huge relief. You all rock. :heart:
Nina: If you want dessert after, Little Orchard's pear galette is small-plate friendly and GF.
Maya: Adding to the list. Appreciate the help everyone! :tada:
